The first release. Free and open source (AGPL-3.0).

**For Minecraft 1.21.11 with Fabric, on Linux.** Needs [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api). Sodium, Iris and Mod Menu are optional and work with it.

### What it does
- Shows the lyrics of the song you're playing (Spotify, a browser, any player that shows up in your desktop's media controls), synced to the music and glowing in the sky.
- A bar at the top of the screen with the album cover, the line being sung and the current word highlighted.
- Animations: word by word, fade, rise, pop or typewriter. A soft pulse when a new line starts.
- Lyrics take the colour of the album cover, or pick your own, or rainbow.
- Optional aurora or nebula in the night sky while music plays.
- Stays bright with shaders on, in rain and above the clouds.
- Timing can be fixed per song if lyrics come early or late.
- Settings screen on **J** (or through Mod Menu), in English and Hebrew.

Lyrics come from [LRCLIB](https://lrclib.net), a free lyrics database. No account needed.

### Install
Put `belis-skylyrics-0.1.0.jar` and Fabric API in your `mods` folder. Step-by-step instructions are in the [README](https://github.com/arbelonson-source/belis-skylyrics#install).
